reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis incorrectly labels W-Cu as a high-entropy alloy and proposes a nano-bridged honeycomb microstructure (fcc/B2) that is not known for W-Cu systems, making the mechanism physically unsound for this immiscible system.
reasons.testability: The test compares mechanical and thermal properties to a baseline, but the described microstructure and mechanism are so ill-defined for W-Cu that the experiment cannot meaningfully test the stated hypothesis.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis is not useful because it misidentifies the material class and proposes a microstructure/mechanism irrelevant to W-Cu, offering no actionable insight for overcoming the known processing limitations.
